acceptanceCriteria: A relative-module helper that asserts (to depth 3) suppresses JS-NO-ASSERTION; one that does not yields it, both pinned by tests.
The imported module is read only when its blob is bound (same confinement as TSA-V0-082); otherwise the fact stays withheld with a named reason.
body: Found in V1-1858 (PR #1161, head 2817789aa, corvint build 664). Expected: an example whose only expectation lives in a helper imported from ./helpers counts as asserting. Actual: JS-NO-ASSERTION is withheld (no fact), so assertion-free examples calling imported helpers go unreported.
title: JS/TS hygiene: follow assertions in helpers imported from relative modules instead of withholding JS-NO-ASSERTION
